items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: No, I never played with Punch on the road. No, never have. But I have played a few jobs that is occasionally around in town.

ctx.x: Yeah, Punch used to play some of those carnival shows too and told us something about him. Did you ever play with Punch on a, run across him on the road?
No, I never played with Punch on the road. No, never have. But I have played a few jobs that is occasionally around in town.
Yeah. Yeah. I was going to ask a bit more about the parades. What did they do? Go right through the main part of town. Did they have any uniforms or manners?
